lead: This PEP drawn from its configuration as it is now: its listeners, and its reverse proxy's routes as a tree by path, each with the application it fronts and who may reach it. Click a route or a listener to open its page; a link in a box opens the application, the role or the policy. A wide picture scrolls inside its box.
label: Remote PEP {name}: its listeners and its reverse proxy's routes
desc: {listeners} listener(s), {proxyListeners} of them serving the reverse proxy, and {routes} route(s).
refused: the PEP refuses this route now
serves: Serves every route of the reverse proxy
key.heading: Key
key.pep: The remote PEP: its name and the hostname it reports
key.envListener: A listener the PEP's environment defines (read-only)
key.definedListener: A listener defined here, on the PEP's Listener tab
key.offListener: Dashed: a listener that is off, or that the PEP has not reported
key.serves: A reverse-proxy listener: it serves every route
key.protected: A route whose access a policy decides: the roles per action, or the policy named
key.public: A public route: anyone may reach it
key.denyAll: A route with no methods: nobody may reach it
key.noRoute: A path segment no route stops at
